name: hustings
title: Hustings
description: A campaign theme for an independent candidate or a residents' campaign: a satin violet rosette pinned beside the mission carries your one figure on its centre button, page headings sit on violet correx boards, and every pledge hangs a ribbon tail — poster-black geometric capitals and a serif on leaflet white.

tokens.--font-display: geometric sans for the capitals: headings, site title, menu, buttons, captions and the rosette's figure
tokens.--font-body: serif for reading text, the mission and ledes
tokens.--text-s: small capitals — menu, captions, dates, table heads, the footer
tokens.--text-l: the site title, ledes, the mission text, list titles and the figures in tables
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text and the programme heading
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles on the correx board and the mission headline
tokens.--text-figure: largest size of the figure on the rosette's button; the whole rosette is drawn in proportion and shrinks on a phone
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings and buttons
tokens.--weight-display: boldness of headings, buttons, the menu and the figure
tokens.--color-bg: leaflet-white page background, and the halo behind the focus ring
tokens.--color-text: poster-black ink for text and headings, heavy rules and the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text — descriptions in lists, dates, the donate prompt, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: satin violet: the rosette's pleats, tails, unit and printed ring, links, the donate button, the last menu entry, the current-page underline and list ribbons
tokens.--color-accent-ink: text on the violet donate button and the last menu entry
tokens.--color-band: the violet correx board behind each page heading
tokens.--color-band-ink: heading text and dates on the correx board
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules between list entries and table rows
tokens.--color-panel: tint behind the get-involved block, code and a loading hero photograph
tokens.--color-button: the white printed centre button of the rosette
tokens.--color-button-ink: the figure printed on the rosette's centre button
tokens.--satin-sheen: light on the satin: the lit side of each pleat and the stripe down each tail
tokens.--satin-shade: shadow on the satin: the dark side of each pleat, tail edges, the shadow under the button
tokens.--flute: the fine vertical flutes of the corrugated board behind page headings
tokens.--gutter: space between the text and the screen edge
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, tags and photographs: nearly square, like cut board
tokens.--rule: thickness of the heavy black rules, the current-page underline and the quote bar
tokens.--focus-ring: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of buttons, menu links and tap targets
